text.p: Consolidated financial results for the year ending December 31, 1996.
NOTES: Company's full name is Alphatec Electronics Plc, a semi-conductor manufacturing firm. Fourth quarter figures not stated.

The company said its 1996 sales rose 8.5 percent but its net dropped 35.3 percent over 1995 because of the sluggish world trade in electronics components last year. It said it has consolidated the operating results of its U.S. subsidiary and its joint venture in China. The two companies had a loss of 78 million baht.

Alphatec also said it has adjusted accounting methods to comply with accounting standards in the United States which made its 1996 profit fall further. The company said it has posted fees of 82 million baht for CD redemption before the due date, which also impacted its bottom line.
